specification.problem: Evaluate the balanced depth-2 NAND formula f(x)=NAND(NAND(x1,x2),NAND(x3,x4)) for explicit classical x in {0,1}^4 via a discrete-time coined quantum walk on a tree with tail, x compiled into gates. The abstract's O(sqrt N) balanced-formula bound is the motivating goal; the general O(N^(1/2+O(1/sqrt(log N)))) bound is out of scope.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Only the N=4 balanced instance. The circuit is the unitary U_x^T on a fixed 8-vertex graph. It is a walk-dynamics demonstration whose output is not shown to decode f(x). The decode statistic and threshold are NOT validated; the paper's actual construction is not reconstructed, and no black-box query claim is made.

symbols.meaning: walker at vertex v in edge slot s
symbols.domain: v in 0..7 (0 tail, 1 root, 2 and 3 internal, 4..7 leaves), s in 0..3 (slot 3 unused)

symbols.meaning: flip-flop shift swapping |u,s_u> with |v,s_v> across each present edge (u,v)
Grover coin on the used slots of v, with degree computed from the x-dependent edge set; phase -1 on a degree-1 vertex slot

symbols.domain: positive integer; heuristic T~ceil(pi*sqrt(N)/2)=4 for N=4, uncalibrated

equations.label: Formula
equations.description: Depth-2 balanced NAND tree, with NAND(a,b)=not(a and b). The NAND of two NANDs equals the OR of the two ANDs.
equations.justification: Boolean identity for the chosen smallest instance.

equations.label: Walk step
equations.latex: U_x=S_x\,C_x,\quad C_x=\bigoplus_{v}C_v(x),\quad C_v=2|s_v\rangle\langle s_v|-I\ \text{on used slots},\ |s_v\rangle=\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{\deg v}}\sum_{s\ \text{used}}|s\rangle
equations.description: Coin at each vertex over its used slots, then flip-flop shift. Absent-leaf convention: a leaf with x_i=0 is disconnected, so its parent's slot for it is UNUSED (degree reduced) and the leaf vertex acts as identity on its isolated state; the leaf is never reached. This removes the earlier inconsistency.
equations.justification: Standard coined-walk form adapted from the sketch; not the paper's exact walk. Used slots are derived from x consistently for both parent and leaf.
assumptions: A leaf is present iff x_i=1
Tail is a single edge, too short for a real scattering analysis

equations.label: Initial state
equations.description: The walker starts at the tail vertex in its only used slot, pointing to the root. This is the all-zero computational basis state.
equations.justification: Start must be a used slot.
assumptions: Little-endian: slot occupies low 2 qubits, vertex the high 3 qubits

equations.label: Evolution
equations.abstract_quote: O(√N) discrete query quantum algorithm for evaluating balanced binary NAND formulas
equations.justification: The sqrt(N) bound suggests T=O(sqrt N) steps, each using one x-dependent operation.

equations.label: Decode statistic
equations.description: Return probability compared with a threshold; the sketch associates reflection with f=1. No validated theta exists. Decoding is offline classical postprocessing, not part of the unitary.
equations.justification: From the sketch only. If no theta and T separate all 16 inputs, the circuit is only a dynamics demo.
assumptions: theta and T must be found by simulation over all 16 inputs
Near-zero energy is not guaranteed by this finite construction

registers.name: vertex
registers.role: vertex index 0..7: 0 tail, 1 root, 2 and 3 internal, 4..7 leaves

registers.name: slot
registers.role: edge slot at the vertex: 0 parent/tail direction, 1 and 2 child directions, 3 unused

specification.initial_state: |t,0> = all-zero state of 5 qubits (vertex=0, slot=0); little-endian with slot in the low qubits.

steps.description: Apply the coin C_x, using degrees derived from x (absent leaves reduce parent degree, and the leaf is isolated), then the flip-flop shift S_x over present edges.
Offline, compute p and compare it to a calibrated theta to give a candidate f(x). This is unvalidated, and f(x) is the reference value.

specification.measurement: None inside the unitary. For analysis, the probability of basis state |t,0> is computed from the final state.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Threshold p at a theta calibrated by simulation over all 16 inputs. No calibration is supplied here. If no theta separates the inputs, the circuit is only a walk-dynamics demo and does not demonstrably compute f(x).
assumptions: Scope limited to depth-2 balanced N=4
x is compiled into gates, so no black-box query claim
Absent-leaf handling: leaf disconnected and parent slot unused
T and theta are uncalibrated free choices
missing_information: The paper's exact walk, weights and phase-estimation or scattering procedure
A longer tail and the energy-near-zero analysis
